crime_highlights: The appellant has a lengthy criminal record with 40 convictions
convicted of impaired driving, dangerous driving, failing to stop while being pursued by the police, and driving while disqualified
rationale_highlights: The trial judge carefully reviewed the Gladue report and took into account the systemic factors that contributed to his offending.
noting the appellant’s moral blameworthiness was reduced
note: Short appeal decision; no narrative of the driving events.

crime_highlights: the appellant and two others, disguised with hoodies and balaclavas, and armed with knives and an imitation handgun, forced their way into the victim’s apartment
When the victim resisted, he was seriously assaulted and threatened with death.
The firearm was pointed at him.
The victim suffered serious injuries, including orbital fractures and the permanent loss of his sight in one eye.
rationale_highlights: The appellant is a member of the Dokis First Nation.
recognizing the impact of the intergenerational trauma experienced by his family and how it has contributed to his drug addiction
note: Appeal court only says trial judge recognized the trauma; effect on sentence not stated.

crime_highlights: Ms. Sharma returned from a trip to Surinam, landing at Toronto Pearson International Airport with a suitcase containing 1971.5 grams of cocaine
She agreed to fly to Surinam to retrieve the drugs in exchange for $20,000 from her boyfriend
she confessed to the RCMP that she had been paid to transport the cocaine
rationale_highlights: Ms. Sharma endured significant personal hardship growing up.
Her grandmother attended two residential schools between the ages of 4 and 16.

together with the Gladue factors which address her personal history, including her grandmother’s attendance at residential school, her survival of sexual violence, her experience in foster care, her lack of education and poverty
a conditional sentence served in the community would have been an appropriate sentence to achieve the sentencing objectives of s. 718.2(e)
note: Constitutional ruling; court states Gladue factors support a conditional sentence.
